tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhi/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i yon tan gzi 'bar yang / /byin rlabs me yi rdul phreng bla ma rje/ /me shel med par mi 'byung de bas na/ /de yi zhabs pad spyi bos gus mchod de/ /gang gsung legs bshad rin chen sna tshogs phreng / /gab dang 'khrugs dang 'thor ba spangs phyir dang / /skal bzang blo chen mgrin pa mdzes slad du/ /tho yig gser gyi skud par brgyu bar bya/ /ka ye grogs dag 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ /rnam mang gsung gi chu gter thos bsam gyis/ /srub par gyis dang rang gzhan rmongs pa'i smag /'phrog byed rnam dpyod nyi zla'i dpal thob 'gyur/ /zhes skabs su bab pa cha tsam klad du brjod nas/ 'dir sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i dgung lo lnga bcu nga gsum yan gyi gsung 'bum rnams dkar chag tu bri ba la don gsum ste/ mdo sngags thun mong ba spyi'i skor/ thun mong ma yin pa bye brag pa'i skor/ zhar byung tha snyad rig gnas thor bu ba'i skor ro/ /dang po la yang bstod tshogs dang / gsung mgur/ zhal gdams sogs kyi skor/ gsan yig dang rnam thar sogs kyi skor gnyis las/ dang po bstod tshogs la/ ka)dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa padma rā ga'i 'phreng ba 'di skabs lngar bcad pa'i don bzang zhing tshig ldebs legs pa zhig yod/ yang gong ma lnga la gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ yang gong bstod tshigs bcad re re byas pa gnyis/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug la bstod pa 'phags mchog ma dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug la sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi sgo nas bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs gnyis/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal thugs rje chen po la bstod pa nor bu'i do shal mkhas rnams dga' ba'i mdzes rgyan/

'di mtshan dang spel bas shin tu legs pa zhig yod/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa'i rgya gzhung phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ rje btsun gyi gsol 'debs skad gnyis sbyar ba/ gnas bcu la bstod pa shlau ka gcig sa paṇa la bstod pa dngos grub mchog stsol 'dod don kun 'grub 'di gsung rtsom rnams kyi thog ma yin/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i mtshan can la gsol 'debs yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing dad pa rab g.yo byin rlabs myur 'jug don gnyis lhun grub/ nyes pa'i mun bsal te tshan pa lnga/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la gsol 'debs legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ snying gi thig le/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bsam pa lhun grub/ nor bu'i phreng mdzes te tshan pa lnga/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol 'debs dgos 'dod bsam 'phel/ ngo mtshar utpa la'i phreng ba/ byin rlabs bde chen 'byung ba/ snyan ngag 'khor lo ngo mtshar snang ba/ bsam don kun 'grub/ yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ dad pa'i myu gu/ byin rlabs myur du 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ bla ma rgyang 'bod snying gi gdung dbyangs/ gdung dbyangs gsol 'debs bsam don kun 'grub ste tshan pa bcu/ de nyid la brtan bzhugs bsam don kun 'grub/ de nyid kyi gsung gi gzegs ma dad pa'i dpal ster/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs 'chi med dbang po'i rnga sgra/ bsam pa lhun grub/ grub mchog mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol/ dngos grub ma lus pa 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu ste tshan pa gnyis/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don 'grub la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog phreng ba/ des mdzad pa'i slob bshad rtsod spong la bsngags brjod/ nags dgon pa chen po la bstod pa rin chen mgul rgyan/ don gnyis lhun grub/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan la bstod pa byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba'i pho nya/

lha rdzas me tog gi chun po/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs/ dad pa'i me tog bdag bstod skul byed dga' bskyed/ brtan bzhugs don gnyis mthar phyin/ brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi kha skong yar ngo'i zla dbang / brtan bzhugs bsam pa lhun grub/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po la gsol 'debs mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i tog dang / dgos 'dod kun 'byung gnyis/ 'phel gdung rin po che sogs la gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phreng mdzes/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa sarga bzhi pa/ 'di de dag gi rnam thar mdor bsdus brjod pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig snang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la bstod pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng / rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub dang / byin rlabs char 'bebs gnyis/ rgyal sras thogs med la gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub/ skyid grong jo bo la gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub/ sgrol dkar tshe khrid brgyud 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa/ 'ba' ra lugs kyi tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon chen po padma la bstod pa bar chad kun sel/ de nyid la gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub/ gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ lam zab brgyud 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/ bde kye gsang gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i kha skong / phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ rig 'dzin bskul gyi kha skong / phur pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong / drag po sgrol dbang gi brgyud 'debs kha skong / drag bskul cho ga'i sgrig rim sogs kyi tho/

rig 'dzin brgyud 'debs bar chad kun bsal/ rig 'dzin bla brgyud la ja mchod 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i kha skong / 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa byin rlabs skul byed/ dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba/ gur drag brgyud 'debs kha skong / bde mchog brgyud 'debs kha skong / phur pa'i brgyud 'debs 'phrin las 'dod 'jo/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong / yang de'i kha skong dkar po'i phyogs kyi bsil zer can/ yang de'i kha skong don gnyis lhun grub/ dmar po skor gsum la bstod pa dngos grub char 'bebs/ thub bstan lha chen gyi mchod rol la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/ der bla bre phul ba'i yi ge rnga chen phul ba'i yi ge lha sa'i jo bo la snyan shal phul ba'i kha yig yin thang la na bza' phul ba'i yi ge sku 'dra mje thod mar mchod rdzas phul ba'i yi ge rten ngo mtshar can rnams la gsol 'debs dgos 'dod kun 'byung / rje nyid la 'jam mgon dbang po'i mtshan can gyis gnang ba'i zhal gdams las zur du bkol ba gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub/ bshags smon re ba kun 'grub/ smon lam thar pa'i sgo 'byed/ gsol 'debs re ba kun 'grub/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs yid ches ldan pa/ byams pa'i sku gsung byon ma'i bstod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku 'dra la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ bshags pa sgrib pa kun sel/ smon lam bsam pa kun 'grub/ gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa don gnyis lhun grub/ gsol 'debs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol/ gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub/ gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa dgos 'dod kun 'grub/ bshags smon gyi tshigs bcad re ba kun 'grub/ rgyal yum dam pa'i ched du mdzad pa'i smon lam gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub/ ci bsam lhun grub/ smon lam re ba kun 'grub/

gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar te gsol 'debs mkhas pa dga' byed/ sbyor drug brgyud 'debs 'phrin las mkha' khyab/ lam 'bras thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyis rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol 'debs dgos 'dod kun 'byung / gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsam don kun 'grub/ bar chad kun sel/ yang bar chad kun sel sde tshan sa gsum/ yang nag po chen po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i kha skong rje 'dis mdzad pa/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa gsang sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs/ bde mchog brgyud 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs rgya mtsho/ dkar bdud kyi bstod pa dge legs phun tshogs/ rang gzhan gyi don du bris pa'i mchod brjod blo gsal tshim byed/ mi dbang karma bstan skyong dbang po la bsngags pa 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen rnams so// ༈ //gsung mgur sogs kyi skor la/ legs bshad yid kyi gdung bsal/ nyams dbyangs mthong ba don ldan/ nyams dbyangs bdag 'dzin mdud grol/ zhal gdams zin bris bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ rjes spyod nyams len gong 'phel gyi yi ge gsung ngag lam 'bras la thos bsam dus kyi rmi lam yi ge nyams dbyangs ngan spyod khrel gtam/ bde mchog bsnyen dus kyi nyams dbyangs/ rang la gros 'debs skyon sel sman mchog nyams dbyangs yon tan 'byung gnas/ bar chad kun sel/ phun tshogs rab rgyas/ snyigs ma'i gtam bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshigs bcad dang rang gi spyod tshul la yid 'byung tshigs bcad lhan cig bsdebs pa/ bdag bstod skul byed rab dga'/ nyams shar yi ge blo ldan dga' bskyed/ nyams dbyangs ngan spyod zug rngu sel byed/ tshe 'di'i zhen pa sel byed/ nyams dbyangs gdan sa ma/ rje mus chen la zhu yig rten gyi yi ge legs bshad yid 'byung skyed byed/

nyams dbyangs gsang ba'i yi ge nyams dbyangs a bzhi ma/ gsol 'debs dad pa'i me tog nyams dbyangs snying gi mun sel/ nyams dbyangs ngan spyod kyi zug rngu bskyed 'bras/ nyams dbyangs yid bde'i myu gu ngan pa'i bsam sbyor la khrel gtam/ nyams dbyangs gong ma'i zhu 'phrin/ rang la smras pa'i nyams dbyangs/ nyams dbyangs zhen gcod ral gri/ snyigs ma'i snang tshul la skyo ba'i gtam/ nyams dbyangs thugs rje nyer bskul/ snying gtam bzod pa gong 'phel/ nyams shar yi ge dge legs 'byung gnas/ rje nyid kyi sngar byung gi tshul rnams smras pa yid kyi shing rta/ bla ma rnam gsum la gdung dbyangs don gnyis lhun grub/ nyams dbyangs bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng / 'bras rtsis gsal byed/ rang lo nyer gsum skabs nyin zhag phrugs re'i dge sbyor gsal 'debs kyi yi ge bslab pa 'bul chog gi yi ge rang lo nyer lnga skabs nyin zhag phrugs re'i dge sbyor gsal 'debs kyi yi ge ḍa ḍi mgon khang bzhengs dus bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge legs bshad snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ sbyor drug sgom dus kyi nyams dbyangs rang sems bde stong gi myu gu dang / rang sems bde stong gi rang gzugs gnyis/ nyams dbyangs rang la gros 'debs so/ ༈ /zhal gdams dang gsung 'phrin gyi skor la/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la zhu yig gnyis/ blo ldan rnams la springs yig sa skya'i chos grwa rgyas byed legs bshad/ lha chen smon lam gyi skabs smras pa'i legs bshad/ gling kha'i bca' yig nyams dbyangs chos rgyal mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas/ bdag po mthu stobs drung la gnang ba'i bka' shog gnyis/ yang dag sgrub mchod kyi tho yig karma phun tshogs rnam rgyal la gnang ba'i gsung shog gnyis/ dpon sa tshe ring rgyal mo la spring yig dbyangs can bsod nams rgyal mo la brtan bzhugs/ yar rgyab dpon chen la gnang ba'i bka' shog gdong dga' ba'i dris lan/ be re rgyal po la bka' shog

sa dkar 'dab ldob la gnang ba'i bka' shog ri sbug spyi par bka' shog bkra shis rab brtan par bka' shog shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas par gdams yig mkhan chen chos rnam rgyal la bka' shog klu sgrub sku skye la gnang ba'i bka' shog chos las pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la bka' shog gnyis/ nyams dbyangs skyo ba'i myu gu yi ge pa ā nanda la gnang ba'i bka' shog chos las pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dang rab 'byams pa kun bsam gnyis la thun mong du bka' tho gnyis/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan la gdams yig gnyis/ karma 'jigs bral rdo rje la gdams yig sprul sku rnam rig pa la gdams yig gzhan la gdams yig smra por yid bde 'byung byed/ nyams dbyangs yid bde'i dpal ster/ rnam dkar la spro ba bskyed gtam/ lam 'jug bzang ngan gyi yi ge rab 'byams kun bsam la nyams dbyangs/ rab 'byams bsod blo la gnang ba'i pho yig nye gnas grwa pa rnams la gdams yig rang gi slob bu 'ga' la smras pa'i yi ge nyams dbyangs blo bde'i myu gu gsang ba'i nyams dbyangs/ dge 'dun 'od zer la gdams yig gnyis/ bka' bcu 'od zer gyi mtha' can la gdams yig drug mchog dman gyi grogs la blang dor bya tshul gyi yi ge ya rabs kyi gtam dpyod ldan yid 'phrog zhal gdams nye lam rab bsngags/ nyams dbyangs yid bde'i myu gu zhal gdams yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ legs bshad dpyod ldan yid kyi shing rta/ zhal gdams don gnyis lhun grub/ ma ti bha tra la gdams yig 'phrin las rin chen grogs mched la gdams yig bklags pas skye med rtogs byed/ byams pa bzang po la nyams dbyangs gdams pa skul byed re skong / rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan la gzungs gzugs kyi dkar chag dngos grub kun 'byung / rje rdo rje bdud 'joms pa la gnang ba'i bka' shog rab 'byams pa bsam gtan la gdams yig don gnyis lhun grub/ phur pa bla ma la bka' shog yo mo sprul sku la bka' shog

sa yam la gnang ba'i bka' shog mkhas rtar shing 'dren dus gnang ba'i bka' shog sgo rum du brtag gtor btsugs pa'i mda' dar kha yig sgo rum du bstan gtor btsugs dus kyi snyan dar kha yig rnams so/ ༈ /gnyis pa gsan yig dang rnam thar sogs kyi skor la/ kha) chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa'i tshul zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed las sarga dang po 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos rjes su bzung ba'i skabs/ gnyis pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga gsum pa rje mus chen gyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga bzhi pa thar rtse nas kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga lnga pa 'jam dbyangs bsod nams lhun grub kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga drug pa rje 'bum chen gyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga bdun pa rje nags dgon pa chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i sarga brgyad pa rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga dgu pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas rjes su bzung ba'i sarga bcu pa 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug mched kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga bcu gcig pa spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan gyis rjes su bzung ba'i sarga rnams so/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab la 'jug tshul gyi yi ge legs bshad dpyod ldan yid 'phrog sa skya pa'i gdung rabs byon tshul ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod dgos 'dod kun 'byung / dpal sa skya'i gnas bshad 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsung rtsom gnang 'phro thor bu bzhugs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ dus mdos chen mo'i byung tshul ngo mtshar phreng ba/ dpal bsam yas kyi bka' srung byon tshul chos skyong dges pa'i yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar rgyas pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ 'bring po yid 'phrog lha'i ljon shing / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i rnam thar rgyas pa bcud kyi thigs phreng rab tu 'phel ba'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i chu gter/

'bring po bcud kyi thigs phreng / sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi rnam thar byin rlabs char 'bebs/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras gsum gyi rnam thar bsdus pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar gsal ba'i me long / dgos 'dod kun 'byung / yang de nyid kyi rnam thar dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i nang gi tshigs bcad rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar ngo mtshar gsal ba'i nyin byed bsod nams rab rgyas/ rje mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar rgyas pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs ngo mtshar sarga gsum pa/ 'bring po yid 'phrog dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bsdus pa utpa la'i chun po/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i rnam thar byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ yang de nyid kyi rnam thar dad pa'i dpal ster kha skong dang bcas pa'i bsdus don logs su bkod pa 'phrin las kun khyab/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam thar dang 'dod dad pa'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i ngo mtshar rba rlabs kyi phreng mdzes/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i rnam thar nor bu'i phreng ba/ a ra pa tsa na'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar slob dpon rtse mos mdzad pa la zhu dag gnang ba rnams so/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa bye brag pa'i skor la/ mdo lugs gtso che ba'i skor dang / rdo rje theg pa gtso bor gyur pa'i skor gnyis las/ dang po la/ yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sgrub tshul 'phrin las mkha' khyab/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul sgrub tshul nyer mkho kun gsal/ gaṇḍa'i rnam gzhag rta bdun rgyal po/ grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag grub mtha' kun shes/ bka' gdams byung tshul legs bshad kun dga'/ bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid yig bka' gdams bstan pa'i sgron me/ bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang gi tshom/

spyod khrid gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul ma rig mun sel/ ston pas cho 'phrul bstan tshul dad pa'i snye ma/ dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i snying po'i tshig nyung don mang bde blag tu rtogs byed/ rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi rnam bshad blo gsal yid 'phrog bzang spyod kyi don 'grel khog phub bde ba can du bsgrod pa'i lam bzang / bde ba can gyi zhing bkod phun tshogs bco brgyad pa/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi smon lam phan yon gyi lung sbyor/ bde ba can gyi smon lam zhing bkod rab tu gsal ba'i me long / bde ba can gyi zhing la bsngags pa dad pa'i chu gter/ smon lam dgos 'dod kun 'byung / 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho sgom tshul bde ba can bsgrod pa'i nye lam/ yang de sgom tshul sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa dang / 'phags pas mdzad pa la zhu dag gnang ba/ rong ston gyi ma la gdams pa'i 'pho ba'i yi ge la zhu dag mdzad pa/ 'pho ba'i man ngag gsal ba 'gro kun bde ster/ sman lha mchod chog gi snying po nyams su len tshul re smon kun 'grub/ sman lha mchod chog gi rnam bshad bsam 'phel don grub nor bu/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i las 'bras gsal ba'i me long gi don 'grel bsod nams rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel tshogs gnyis bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng mdzes/ rgyu 'bras theg pa'i spyi don mdo sngags bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sgo 'byed rnams so/ ༈ /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa gtso bor gyur pa la/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor dang / gsar ma'i skor/ de dag la thun mong du dgos pa'i skor dang gsum las/ dang po la/ ta) snying ma spyi'i rnam gzhag phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i byung tshul gyi yi ge rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bklags pas don 'grub kyi rnam bshad 'phrin las kyi padmo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi rnam bshad gnam lcags rdo rje'i dbal gyi rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi me chen 'phrin las 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/

phur pa'i dbyangs rol brjed tho/ dus gtor chen mo'i bdag bskyed phur chen mdzad skabs kyi dbyangs res rol mo sogs kyi brjed tho/ phur bu'i 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub kyi bsdus don 'phrin las kun khyab/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge don gnyer kun smon/ 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub las logs su bkod pa'i stangs stabs kyi 'cham dpe 'phrin las bsam 'phel/ rnying ma'i zhus lan zin bris srad pa kun blos mdzad pa la zhu dag gnang ba rnams so/ ༈ /gnyis pa gsar ma'i skor la/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i skor dang / bla med kyi skor gnyis kyi/ dang po la/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub dkyil 'chi med dpal ster/ tshe mdo'i rnam bshad tshe dang bsod nams rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ tshe sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal/ grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe khrid bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ tshe sgrub 'chi med bdud rtsi 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ tshe sgrub zab mo 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len/ yang tshe sgrub zab mo gcig sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid nyams su len tshul bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / sgrol dkar bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dad pa skyed byed/ yo ga'i skor la/ kun rig gi bsnyen pa dang sbyin sreg bya tshul ma nor don gsal/ sbyong rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ yo ga'i chos 'byung yo ga chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ gzhan phan rnam gnyis kyi gsal byed sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i 'phro kha bskangs pa don gnyis lhun grub/ bkra shis kyi yi ge dge legs kun 'byung / sngags 'chang chen po'i kun rig chog bsgrigs las dbang chog logs su bkod pa/ gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi rnam bshad gzhung don gsal ba'i sgron me/ gzhan phan mtha' yas kyi lung sbyor rin chen 'phreng ba/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnas legs bshad kun 'dus/

bar do chos bshad sgrib pa kun bsal rnams dang / rab gnas kyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag rgyud sde bzhi char la thun mong du sbyar nas byar rung ba yin kyang / rab gnas kyi rgyud chung 'di rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med gnyis kyi thun mong ba yin pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi khongs su bsdus na/ 'di skor la rab gnas kyi cho ga don gnyis lhun grub blo gsal dga' ston/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sgrub tshul phun tshogs kun 'byung / rten bskyed kyi yi ge ma rig mun sel/ rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba'i rnam bshad rab gnas bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed rnams so/ /gnyis pa bla med kyi skor la/ pha rgyud kyi skor/ ma rgyud kyi skor/ gnyis med kyi rgyud kyi skor/ de'i khongs su gtogs pa'i chos skyong gi skor dang bzhi las/ dang po 'dod chags can gtso bor 'dul ba la gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor la/ da) nyid kyi gsung la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas zin bris mdzad pa'i chos 'byung dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa yid 'phrog lha'i rol mo/ yang 'dus pa'i chos 'byung gsang 'dus chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 'di ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos tshul ma lus pa gsal ba'i 'dren byed zung du snang ngo / /sngags 'chang chen po'i gsang 'dus dkyil chog gi mchan bu ma dag pa'i 'khrul sel/ de las 'phros pa'i dris lan gnyis/ gsang 'dus sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad nges don 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas/ 'di ni gtso bor sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad yin yang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i don rnams kyang gsal bar bshad snang ngo / /yang zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba gshin rje gshed kyi skor la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa gtor chog dang bcas pa bdud dpung bsreg pa'i me 'od/ 'jigs byed kyi man ngag yang gsang mthu bzlog nag po nyams su len tshul bstan dgra'i srog dbugs len pa'i bshan pa nag po/

gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs blo dman dga' ba skyed byed/ gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa dngos grub bsam 'phel/ na) gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 'di ni gshed skor gyi chos skor phra rags kun rnam par bkra ba'i me long du snang ngo / /'jigs byed sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me 'od rnams so/ /gnyis pa ma rgyud kyi skor la/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i nye lam/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi sgrub thabs rnam bshad rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub dkyil la nyer mkho'i yi ge bcud kyi thig le/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid yig tshogs bsgom pa'i gsung la zhus dag mdzad pa/ dril bu pa'i lus dkyil lung sbyor yid bde'i dpal ster/ pa) bde mchog chos 'byung bde mchog chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i gsang lam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'gro kun mkha' spyod bsgrod pa'i myur lam/ bde mchog yab yum gyi 'pho ba'i yi ge mal lo'i gsung la sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len snying po/ yang mal lo'i gsung sa chen gyis bris pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba sgom tshul/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad mkha' spyod lam bzang gsal ba'i nyin byed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i myur lam dang / de'i gsang lam rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gser chos chig brgyud/ rnal 'byor ma'i gser chos chig brgyud ma tshar chen gyis mdzad pa la zhus dag gnang ba/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma'i yi ge de nyid kyi dris lan dogs gcod zin bris/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser chos chig brgyud ma'i man ngag sogs kyi zhal shes khag che ba 'ga' zhig sa lo'i phyag dpe las logs su bkod ba/ laṅka li ya sgrub pa bya tshul bklags chog ma/ nag po rim bzhi'i zur 'debs sangs rgyas dpal bas mdzad pa la zhus dag gnang ba/ bde mchog pho brang gi tshad bshad pa blo gsal mig thur/ go cha'i lha brtsigs chen mo'i gsal byed/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i ngag 'don bsam 'phel nor bu/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa 'phrin las mkha' khyab/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi khog phub bde mchog rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed rnams so/ /gsum pa gnyis med kyi skor la/ rgya che ba gnyis med kyi skor dang / zab pa gnyis med kyi skor gnyis las/ dang po la/ pha) dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud dang man ngag 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bstan bcos dus 'khor bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/ ba) dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos 'byung ba'i tshul ngo mtshar dad pa'i shing rta/ dus bzang ngos 'dzin dang / de'i mdzes rgyan/ rigs ldan chen po'i sku gdung gi lo rgyus rnams so/ /gnyis pa zab pa gnyis med kyi skor la/ rgyud kyi skor/ man ngag gi skor/ de gnyis kyi thun mong gi skor dang gsum las/ dang po la/ dges mdzad rdo rje'i chos skor 'chad pa'i sngon 'gro'i spyi bshad 'phrin las rab rgyas/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi don 'grel khog phug rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig 'dis rtsa rgyud kho na'i bshad kha tshang la ma nor ba zhig 'chad par nus so/ / ma) yang rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi tshig 'grel rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ 'dis ni rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod par 'chad nus shing / kyai rdor rgyud bshad kyi sngon 'gro rgyud sde spyi rnam la nyer mkho'i yi ge dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi zin bris la zhu dag gnang ba blo gsal mig thur/

tshul gsum gsal rgyan gyi don 'grel khog phub pad dkar phreng mdzes/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan gyi don 'grel khog phub rin po che'i phreng mdzes/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi don 'grel tshul bzhi dang bcas pa'i zin bris rin po che'i gter mdzod/ 'di mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la rgyud gsum gyi bshad kha gsan dus zin bris su mdzad pa shin tu legs shing don 'dus pa zhig gnang ngo / /kyai rdo rje'i rgyud dang man ngag 'chad tshul gyi zin bris/ kun dga' mchog ldan pa'i gsung la zhu dag gnang ba/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa rin chen phreng ba'i don 'grel khog phub 'phrin las mkha' khyab/ bstod pa de nyid mchan bu'i sgo nas zhib tu bshad pa yid 'ong lang tsho rgyas pa'i bzhin ras gsung rab tshig don la chags pa'i skyes bu'i yid 'phrog dga' bde'i dpal ster/ gnyis pa man ngag gi skor la/ kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi chos skor la slob tshul don gnyer kun dga'/ gsung ngag chos 'byung bsdus pa don gnyer dga' ba skyed byed/ gsung ngag chos 'byung rgyas pa khog phub dang bcas pa legs bshad 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel khog phub blo gsal yid bde 'byung ba'i dga' tshal/ snang gsum mdzes rgyan dang rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi sa bcad logs su bkod pa rin chen 'phreng ba/ bla ma dam pa'i lam 'bras gsung dus kyi gnad kyi zin bris rgyal lha khang pa blo gros seng ges mdzad pa zhib tu bshad pa/ bar ston zin bris kyi shin tu zab pa'i gsung sgros rnams logs su bkod pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo/ rje mus chen gyi dris lan rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas/ gsung ngag la nye bar mkho ba'i brag phug pa dang bla ma dam pa'i gsung rgyun rnams phyogs gcig tu bris pa zab don bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ lam 'bras 'khrul 'khor gyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa rnal 'byor kun dga'/

rlung gi rnam bshad mun sel sgron me/ nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor bya tshul don gnyis mthar phyin/ kyai rdor gyi rtsa sngags kyi rnam bshad zab don rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig gong ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi man ngag gi rgya mtsho/ brda' don gsal ba/ brda' chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi phyag len gyi yi ge don gnyis lhun grub/ brda' chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu/ sa skya pa'i yab chos lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid yig sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rtsom 'phro can kha bskangs pa don gnyis lhun grub 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dga' ston/ mu gu lung gi phug pa bcu gsum gyi ngos 'dzin/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub thabs ma nor don gsal/ de'i dkyil chog 'phrin las kun khyab/ de'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las rab rgyas/ de'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul blo gsal kha 'byed/ de'i bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba la zhu dag mdzad pa/ kyai rdor mngon rtogs kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul nyer mkho kun dga'/ kyai rdor mngon rtogs kyi rnam bshad zin bris 'jam dbyangs dgongs rgyan/ kyai rdor mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa'i dka' gnas kyi bshad pa zab don bcud kyi snying po/ rdo rje lus kyi rnam bshad rdo rje theg pa'i khang bzang mdzes par byed pa'i rin po che'i rgyan phreng rnams so/ /kyai rdor yab yum gnyis ka'i phyi nang gi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad dgyes rdor chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 'dir ni kyai rdor yab yum gnyis ka'i phyi dkyil nang dkyil gyi rnam gzhag zhib tu bshad pa'i steng du 'bras bu sa lam bsgrod tshul gyi rnam gzhag kyang dpyod ldan rna ba'i bdud rtsir gyur pa zhig snang ngo / /gsum pa de gnyis kyi thun mong ba'i skor la/

sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong rnam gnyis kyi so so'i bzhed srol legs par bshad pa'i lugs gnyis zab don gsal ba'i nyin byed/ bzhi pa de'i khongs su gtogs pa chos skyong gi skor la/ zha) drug cu pa'i dris lan yi ge gsar rnying legs bshad log rtog 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje/ chos skyong skor gyi chos 'byung rgyas pa bstan srung chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed/ 'di na gur zhal gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i sa skya pa'i chos skyong dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud lcam dral/ gur mgon gyi las mkhan rnams dang bcas pa'i chos kyi byung tshul ma lus pa gsal lo/ /gur mgon khro bcu'i rjes gnang bya tshul bdud kyi dpung tshogs zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i me 'od/ mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub kyi man ngag bdud sde 'joms pa'i gnam lcags/ gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg don gnyer dga' bskyed bar chad kun sel/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral las mkhan dang bcas pa'i bstod bskul 'phrin las myur du sgrub pa'i pho nya/ sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge yid bzhin nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung / bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes kyi thugs rje la bskul ba'i yi ge sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams kyi rtsa sngags sogs kyi don bshad pa dpe rnying yid ches can las bshus pa/ chos skyong gi rten la gzungs gzhug tshul thun mong ma yin pa 'phrin bcol rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ chos skyong rnams kyi bskang bshags 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa yid kyi 'dod 'jo dang / don gnyis lhun grub gnyis/ tsa turmu kha'i bstod bskul dgra sde 'joms pa'i mtshon cha/ zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso bsdus pa bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal/ zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa bsam don myur 'grub/ zhal bzhi pa la gtang rag mchod gsol ngo mtshar rin po che'i 'phreng mdzes/

pu tra'i bskang gso 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa bsam don myur 'grub/ pu tra 'khor bcas la mchod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs bcad don gnyis lhun grub/ pu tra'i bstod pa bdud dpung kun 'joms/ pu tra la gtang rag mchod gsol dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu'i phreng ba/ pu tra khang du spyan gzigs phul ba'i 'phrin bcol/ pu tra'i 'cham gyi brjed byang bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra/ sa skya pa'i bstan srung rnams kyi drag bskul bstan dgra'i srog rtsa gcod par byed pa'i mtshon cha dang / bsam don myur 'grub gnyis/ dur khrod bdag po'i bskang bshags bzlog bskul bstod pa dang bcas pa bsam don kun 'grub/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i bstod bskul 'phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i pho nya/ chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu kun khyab drag po rtsal la 'phrin las bcol ba'i yi ge bsam don kun 'grub/ rnam thos sras 'khor bcas mchod pa'i cho ga dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rin po che'i gter mdzod rnams so/ /gsum pa de dag la thun mong du dgos pa'i chos skor la/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i rnam bshad rje btsun mchog gi dgongs rgyan/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang rnams la med thabs med pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i sman mchog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho/ rdor dril gyi rnam bshad sngags 'chang rnams la gces pa'i nor rdzas/ rdo rje dril bu/ bgrang phreng / dgang blug bum pa rnams kyi rnam bshad 'phrin las kun khyab/ bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam bshad bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ rigs sngags kyi 'dul ba rnam par 'byed pa 'khrul spong mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 'di nyid du paṇa chen byams pa gling pa sogs kyis rtsa ltung 'khrul spong la brgal zhing brtags pa mang du mdzad pa rnams kyi lan/ paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can gyis mdzad tshul sogs dang sbyar nas chos kyi dag byed mang du mdzad pa yang snang ngo /

/rnal 'byor bla med kyi phyi dang nang gi yul chen gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus bshad pa'i yi ge sdom gsum rab dbye'i bsdus don blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed/ gzhal yas khang gi rnam bshad ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal ba'i mig thur rnams so/ /gsum pa zhar byung tha snyad rig gnas kyi skor dang / thor bu'i rnam grangs la/ brda' gsar rnying gi shan 'byed gsung rab kun la lta ba'i sgron me/ legs sbyar klog tshul gyi bstan bcos blo gsal kun dga'/ bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba/ yang dag yig nyung ngu gcig don rgyan so lnga'i rnam bshad blo gsal gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan yid 'ong utpa la'i phreng ba/ sgra rgyan gyi bstan bcos mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog blo gsal mgul rgyan rnams dang / thor bu ba la/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs lam dus sogs nyer mkho'i yi ge rje dam pas mdzad pa rnams la zhus gtugs gnang ba dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams kyi yid 'phrog 'di na lam dus gnad bsdus rgyas nyung gnyis/ lam zab chag med gnad bsdus/ bir bsrung gnad bsdus/ rnal 'byor ma gnad bsdus rnams yod do/ /dril bu rim lnga'i log rtog bsal byed gung rus mdzad pa la zhus dag gnang ba/ nag po pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul/ de'i gzhi bsnyen dang kha gso byed tshul 'phrin las bsam 'phel/ bde mchog gi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston/ bde mchog gi sngags phreng mchan bcas/ nyams len zab mo'i rim pa rnams gsal 'debs pa'i yi ge ting nge 'dzin gong 'phel/ nag po chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrub thabs kha'u brag rdzong gi rgyun gyi snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba/ ku ru kulle'i bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi lam nyams su len tshul gyi gnad bsdus/ bde mchog nag po pa'i mngon rtogs bsgom don bsdus pa ting 'dzin rab gsal/

bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams len snying po/ sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs snying po 'chi med dpal ster/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs snying po rgyal 'gong kun 'dul/ gur drag nyams len bsdus pa/ sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbrags sgrub kyi snying po/ slob dpon rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa/ tshe sgrub nye brgyud kyi nyams len snying po/ khyung khra'i sgom don snying po/ gur drag gi sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ tshe sgrub mda' 'phel ma'i sgom bzlas snying po/ tshe sgrub mda' 'phel ma'i sgrub thabs dang dbang bskur bya tshul 'chi med lhun grub/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsam pa lhun grub/ nang gi brag rdzong ma bsgom tshul/ phyag rdor u tsha'i sgom bzlas snying po/ nai gu chos drug gi rgyun gyi nyams len rnal 'byor gdeng thob/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma 'phrin las rab rgyas/ ye shes khyung nag sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ dzam dmar gyi man ngag zab mo nyams su len tshul gyi snying po/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub/ dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag tsakra la brten nas dbang bsdus zab mo'i lag len gyi yi ge bsam 'phel nor bu/ so so 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs bsam don kun 'grub/ nā ga rakṣa'i sgrub thabs ma rig mun sel/ yang de'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul ma rig mun sel/ gdon sgrol gyi cho ga'i lag len gyi yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel/ chu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs/ klu gtor gtong tshul gyi yi ge dgos 'dod char 'bebs/ nam gdon gyi nad mi 'byung ba'i gdams pa zab mo nyes pa kun sel/ 'dra 'dri chos sde'i bca' yig bsam don kun 'grub/ dmag zor ma dang chos skyong gzhan rnams lhan cig tu mchod gtor 'bul tshul gyi yi ge

'phags pa rin po che la ldan ma dbang phyug 'bum gyi dri ba zhus pa'i dris lan rnam par nges pa'i don 'brel mthong ba rab dga'/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la grangs chen bco brgyad las brtsams pa'i dri ba dris lan gyi yig chung / jo gdan bla ma mang thos bshes gnyen pa'i dris lan yid kyi mun sel/ dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod kyi dbang gsum pa'i skabs kyi gsal byed zab don rgyas pa'i thabs mchog rgyud sde bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgron me/ sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bum dkar chag rin chen phreng ba/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po'i bka' 'bum dkar chag nor bu'i phreng ba/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi bka' 'bum dkar chag padmo'i phreng ba/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched/ mus chen/ rgyal yum dam pa rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung gsum sogs kyi gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag dad pa skyed byed/ bris thang gtso bsdus chen mo'i dkar chag yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng mdzes/ rje mus chen gyi dngul sku'i gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal dang / chos rgyal mthu stobs dbang phyug sku mched kyi dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung rnams kyi gzungs gzhug dkar chag dngos grub gling du sku thang sogs phul ba'i dkar chag 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge dbu rtser gser phan phul ba'i dkar chag bde mchog pho brang la zhig gso gnang dus kyi dkar chag rig 'dzin lha khang du bzhengs pa'i mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra rin po che'i gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag grub mchog mthu stobs dbang po'i nang rten dngul gdung sogs kyi dkar chag gdan sa chen po'i sgrub mchod kyi skabs bshad las pa rnams kyis bshad bya'i bstan bcos kyi tho yig mun sel yar ngo'i zla ba/ rje nyid kyi dgung lo so brgyad yan la mgon po'i ljags bsnyen song tho/

ngam ring chos sder mang ja gser 'gyed gnang dus kyi bsngo yig rdor phreng sogs dkyil thang nyer gcig bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag yang gsang ha la nag po'i be'u bum gyi dkar chag bla ma dang zhing skyong dges pa'i mchod rdzas/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi don 'grel mang po phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi chos 'byung zab yangs chos sgo 'byed pa'i rin chen lde mig dgos 'dod kun 'byung / yo ga'i chos 'byung yo ga bstan pa'i sgo 'byed/ gsang 'dus chos 'byung ngo mtshar rin po che'i bang mdzod/ rab gnas don gsal gyi dgongs 'grel rin po che'i gter mdzod/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos 'byung yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba dgos 'dod kun 'byung / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i rnam thar dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng rnam par g.yo ba/ ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed lugs gnyis gsal ba'i nyin byed rnams so/ /de skad dkar chag nor bu'i do shal gang / /tshig 'jam srad bur bstar nas blo gros kyi/ /lang tsho dar babs don gnyer 'dzum dkar ba/ /mang po'i mgul pa mdzes rgyan bkod byed mkhan/ /thun mong dngos grub nor gyi dpal yon can/ /gshen bon rigs su skyes kyang mchog siddhi/ /yid bzhin 'dod 'jor sred nas shākya'i bstan/ /rin chen gan mdzod sgor zhugs thos bsam la/ /cig tu 'grus pa'i bgyi ba mi dman zhing / /rje btsun bla ma'i bka' drin 'od phreng gis/ /snying gi ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i bha danta/ /bsam gtan ming gis bod de'o dge gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 18 bsam gtan/ bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag bhadanta bsam gtan gyis mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
